It is turning toward commerce: an undated site banner announces the acquisition of pirawna and uptickk to offer end to end commerce, and its September 2026 resources are BFCM briefings for CMOs. A rival should know the measurement lead rests on unnamed cases: 11 of its 18 clients are names only, and the 7 observed are coded mostly to organic, commerce and brand, none to measurement.

openings:
The strongest opening is proof under the lead line. It leads with Data & Measurement, yet no named client carries a data and measurement or paid performance need; the incrementality and ROAS work sits in unnamed cases. It is likely, moderate confidence, that a rival showing named, dated incrementality results wins measurement led pitches in CPG, fashion and beauty. Falsifier: a named client case with a matched market or MMM result on its site at the next compile.

Second, the observed contradictions: it sells paid social with no social ad pixel on its own site and runs no LinkedIn ads of its own; a rival showing its own pixel and ad record likely wins that comparison. Third, it sells GEO with no audited AI visibility product (P1 partial) and no sign of testing ads inside AI assistants (P8 absent): a rival with a citation share scorecard leads with the number (likely).
